messages:
Mike: quick sync — prepping a latency deep-dive for sprint planning. can someone drop the canonical dashboards/panels for p50/p95/p99, TTFT, and tokens/sec? I want to reference exact panels in the doc and link them in the PR.
Sara: sure — primary ones we use: Grafana -> Infra / Latency Overview (TTFT by model) and Tokens dashboard. panels: p50/p95/p99, TTFT heatmap, tokens/sec timeseries. link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/1/latency-overview (replace with perms) :link:
Leah: Jaeger traces for slow TTFT are under the "inference-service" trace stream. Search service=inference and tag span.name=generate. sampling is 5% by default; can bump for a short window. Jaeger link: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search?service=inference
Mike: thanks. any recommended PromQL snippets to calculate TTFT p95 across models? want something I can paste in the doc.
Sara: example (approx):
```
# p95 TTFT per model over 5m
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```
Also tokens/sec (per model): `sum(rate(token_emitted_total[1m])) by (model)`
Julian: fyi, we recently moved some panels. canonical folder is "infra/latency/production" — if link 404s, try the folder root. I also added a bookmark in the team dashboard.
devops-bot: new dashboard published: infra/latency/production (id: 42) — auto-notify on updates.
Leah: small caveat — our p99 alert (infra_latency_p99_rule) is noisy for small models. we should either increase the threshold or lengthen the evaluation window. currently triggers at > 1.2s p99 over 5m. suggestion: 1.4s over 10m for models < 1B params.
Mike: @Sara can you take a quick pass on that alert change? I'll open the PR for the dashboard link + doc. PR #4321.
Sara: on it — will add a note and link to the eval we ran last week. can you include one failing example trace so I can validate the threshold?
Mike: yep attaching snippet of a slow request (trimmed):
```
POST /v1/generate  latency: 1.8s  model: small-1b  tokens: 128
trace_id: 7f3a2c1b
```
Leah: I'll add a short section to the obs onboarding (where to find TTFT panels + how to adjust sampling) so new folks don't ask repeatedly.
Sara: quick CR ping — I reviewed #4321, left one comment about panel refresh interval. mike, can you address and I'll merge? :thumbsup:
Mike: will update today. thanks all :)
